articles.title_en: Russia, Ukraine Agree on Ceasefire in Embattled Oleshky, Plan New Peace Talks Next Month
articles.lead_en: The pause in fighting will allow for the delivery of humanitarian aid and facilitate civilian evacuations from the town, the White House said.

articles.title_en: Evacuation of residents from Alyoshki may take several days — Kremlin spokesman
